messages:
Marta (CS): quick heads-up — NimbusCo usage dropped ~65% last week, mostly embedding calls. noticed after the weekend surge ended.
Jamal (AE): ugh, timeline? did they switch model or do a pilot w/ someone else?
Marta (CS): last active heavy day was 1755400000 in logs. no flagged incidents. Olivia (CSM): had a customer check-in scheduled next Tues, I can push earlier.
Riley (Procurement @NimbusCo): FYI we were asked by finance to pause non-essential API spend while procurement reviews vendor shortlist. they mentioned a price-performance bakeoff.
Jamal (AE): that explains it. any named competitors? Riley (Procurement @NimbusCo): they referenced "BlueOak AI" and an internal ML infra pilot.
Marta (CS): ok — immediate asks: (1) help procurement quantify TCO vs BlueOak (2) a short usage report + latency/cost breakdown they can share w/ finance (3) propose a quick pilot to show value retention under their production mix.
Olivia (CSM): I can assemble a one-pager and 2-slide exec summary. need a token-level cost delta and 90/95th latency numbers for the last month. Support Bot: exported billing and perf slices for account nimbus-001: jobs/1755557777/export.csv (link)
Jamal (AE): I'll offer a 60-day dedicated trial pricing option and propose a structured pilot with traffic mirroring. Marta (CS): Let's set objectives for the pilot: (A) 80% of previous successful calls preserved, (B) cost within 10% after batching/quant suggestions, (C) clear rollback.
Riley (Procurement @NimbusCo): procurement wants legal/terms checklist too — IP/data residency notes. can you send those?
Olivia (CSM): Sending: short checklist + proposed SLA tweaks (will DM legal). Jamal (AE): I'll include a competitor comparison spreadsheet and highlight our downgrade fallbacks. Marta (CS): Plan for next 48h: Olivia to send executive one-pager, Jamal to share pricing/pilot, Marta to prepare usage/regression snippets and 3 prompt examples for eval. Riley — can you share the internal eval criteria (metrics they care about)?
Riley (Procurement @NimbusCo): yes, will send doc by EOD. main metrics: token cost, 95th latency, error rate, and model output drift on 3 canonical prompts.
Marta (CS): perfect. tagging @Olivia and @Jamal — please ack when items are uploaded. i'll track in the renewal playbook and ping legal for the checklist. :thumbsup:
Olivia (CSM): ack — will have one-pager + slides in 6-8 hours.
Jamal (AE): ack — pricing & competitor sheet in 8 hours.
Support Bot: reminder: renewal playbook item created: playbooks/renewal/nimbus-001-1755557777 (link)
Marta (CS): thanks team. if procurement escalates to execs, we'll propose a short call with product to demo latency under mirrored traffic. keep updates here. :coffee:
